reference_sql:
SELECT quarter,
       COUNT(*) AS n_days,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_weekend) / COUNT(*), 1) AS weekend_pct
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY quarter
alternatives: SELECT quarter, COUNT(*) AS n_days, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS weekend_pct FROM calendar WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY quarter
SELECT quarter, COUNT(*) AS n_days, ROUND(100 * AVG(CAST(is_weekend AS INTEGER)), 1) AS weekend_pct FROM calendar WHERE cal_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT quarter, COUNT(*) AS n_days, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS weekend_pct FROM calendar WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY quarter
other_way.tradeoff: Works in every SQL dialect, but is wordier than FILTER.
